--- README.md
+++ README.final-v2.md
@@ -12,10 +12,16 @@
 | Actual closed outcome, if observed | Permitted next decision | Retained block / stop condition |
 | --- | --- | --- |
 | `BLOCKED_GUARD`, producer/source mismatch, incomplete read, cleanup failure, or expected G31 replay mismatch | Resolve the operational evidence discrepancy from retained receipts before interpreting a source category. Preserve partial exposure and consumed slots. | No format diagnosis or new slot/retry is implied. An unreliable or unavailable source/receipt binding stops this Li attempt. |
-| A supported strict-profile restriction: e.g. `MEMBER_FLAGS`, `MEMBER_COMPRESSION`, `MEMBER_VERSION`, central extra/comment presence, or a local-extra growth-family failure; independently safe findings remain coherent | Consider **one separately frozen complete compatible-reader design**, only after retained authoritative format evidence identifies an exact finite rule and its dependencies. A family name alone does not identify a legal feature. Keep every old profile and failed result unchanged. | No automatic relaxation. Unknown/mixed features, unsupported encryption, or no defensible bounded design retain the block. Do not erase a flag, rewrite the archive, treat an unknown extra as A220, or infer legality from a successful library load. |
+| A potentially supportable strict-profile restriction: e.g. `MEMBER_KIND_PROFILE`, `MEMBER_FLAGS`, `MEMBER_COMPRESSION`, `MEMBER_VERSION`, central extra/comment presence, or a local-extra growth-family failure; independently safe findings remain coherent | Consider **one separately frozen complete compatible-reader design**, only after retained authoritative format evidence identifies an exact finite rule and its dependencies. A family name alone does not identify a legal feature. Keep every old profile and failed result unchanged. | No automatic relaxation. Unknown/mixed features, unsupported encryption, or no defensible bounded design retain the block. Do not erase a flag, rewrite the archive, treat an unknown extra as A220, or infer legality from a successful library load. |
 | Local CRC/size/version/flag/method/name agreement or alignment failure | Determine whether a documented format feature changes the relevant premise. For example, an unencrypted data descriptor can defer local CRC/sizes; supporting it requires complete descriptor boundaries, central reconciliation and applicable checks, not a wider mask. | Without that exact justification, retain the contradiction. G34's broad categories do not establish descriptor presence or distinguish every legal feature from malformed data. Previously accepted method-8 option flags cannot simply explain a new flags rejection. |
 | Definite out-of-buffer/directory bounds, truncation, overlapping or duplicate local associations, conflicting identity/path, unresolvable central framing, or required-member absence | Preserve the exact failure and every safely observed fact. Treat ambiguous associations as unavailable, never as a source of speculative local reads. | If these are genuine contradictions under the justified format, stop the Li reader route for this release. Missing required workbook roles stop the present documentary route. Do not call every old-profile mismatch corruption, but never repair contradictions by guessing offsets or member identities. |
 | `INCOMPLETE_NO_FAILURE_OBSERVED`, `FAILURES_AND_INCOMPLETE`, or any `NOT_CHECKED_*` dependency | Carry the unresolved dependency into the decision. Safe fixed-header facts may survive an outgoing extent failure; incoming ambiguous associations do not become safe because they also own an extent. | Incomplete is not pass. A compatible design must resolve the dependency by justified bounded structure, not by interpreting withheld bytes speculatively. If it cannot, stop. `NOT_APPLICABLE` establishes only inapplicability. |
+
+`MEMBER_KIND_PROFILE` identifies a strict part-name/profile restriction, not the
+member name, its actual type or whether it is a valid package part. Any complete
+Open Packaging Conventions (OPC) compatibility design must justify bounded
+content-type and relationship rules together; it must not guess a name or
+silently accept arbitrary parts. The actual G34 category remains unknown here.
 
 The retained PKWARE interpretation supports the distinction between method-specific
 option flags, descriptors and encryption; it does not identify this source's next
@@ -64,8 +70,8 @@
 to a count. Preserve article-local citation IDs: the known CR49/CR50 DOI collision forbids
 DOI-only union. Compare lineage to authenticated target-redacted exposed-source manifests,
 keeping composition reuse, measurement/campaign reuse and computational provenance distinct.
-No endpoints, target hashes, numerical ranges, ranker scores, thresholds, allocations or
-model/split choices belong in this projection.
+No numerical endpoint values, target hashes, numerical ranges, ranker scores,
+thresholds, allocations or model/split choices belong in this projection.
 
 End with a named decision: metadata supports a specified finite recorded-label frame,
 or pairing/frame/meaning/use terms remain unknown or refuted and that claim stops.
